title: VIGOR: Verifiable Industrial Geometry Optimization and Repair in Scene Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.13145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate structured layouts and executable scene programs from natural-language instructions. However, executability does not imply engineering feasibility: an industrial scene program may execute successfully while its final state still violates coupled boundary, collision, clearance, aisle, or structural constraints. We identify this mismatch as the executability-engineering-feasibility gap, where locally plausible placements can remain globally infeasible because corrections to one device may introduce violations elsewhere. To make this gap measurable in a controlled setting, we construct an execution-grounded industrial scene-program dataset with 1,749 constructible scenarios, complete executable programs, and 94 final-state geometric checks per scenario. translated_title: VIGOR：场景程序中可验证的工业几何优化与修复
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益能够根据自然语言指令生成结构化布局和可执行的场景程序。然而，程序可执行并不意味着工程可行性：一个工业场景程序可能成功执行，但其最终状态仍会违反耦合边界、碰撞、间隙、通道或结构等约束。我们将这种不匹配定义为“可执行性与工程可行性之间的鸿沟”，即局部看似合理的设备摆放可能全局不可行，因为对某一设备的修正可能在其他位置引入新的违规。为了在可控环境中使这一鸿沟可度量，我们构建了一个基于执行的工业场景程序数据集，包含1,749个可构建场景、完整的可执行程序，以及每个场景94项最终状态几何检查。我们进一步提出VIGOR，它将监督式场景程序生成与基于执行的验证和分阶段几何修复相结合……
tldr: 该论文识别了大语言模型生成的场景程序中“可执行但不工程可行”的鸿沟，提出VIGOR框架结合基于执行的验证与分阶段几何修复，并构建了包含1,749个场景和每场景94项几何检查的工业场景程序数据集，实现工业布局的可验证优化与自动修复。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies the executability-engineering-feasibility gap in LLM-generated scene programs and proposes VIGOR, which combines execution-grounded verification with staged geometric repair, supported by a dataset of 1,749 industrial scenarios with 94 final-state geometric checks each, enabling verifiable optimization and repair of industrial layouts.
